page_title: WER 2-2 MON | Werder Bremen v B. Monchengladbach 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
90+2' Marvin Ducksch goes off the pitch and Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) comes on.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Michael Zetterer.
90+1' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+1' The B. Monchengladbach players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+1' Referee Timo Gerach makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Werder Bremen players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
85' Dangerous play by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach). Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Here is a change. Leonardo Bittencourt is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
81' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
79' It is time for a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is on for Rocco Reitz.
76' Substitution. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) replaces Nick Woltemade.
76' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) replacing Anthony Jung.
73' The Werder Bremen players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
71' Substitution. Franck Honorat walks off the pitch and Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
71' Substitution. Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) on for Marvin Friedrich.
70' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Manu Kone is replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
69' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
65' 2 - 1 Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. The score is 2:1.
65' The ball goes out for a corner. Werder Bremen can continue in their attacking effort.
64' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
56' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

55' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Timo Gerach with no other option than to blow for a foul.

54' Werder Bremen are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
51' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
46' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Tomas Cvancara comes on the pitch for Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 - 1 Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
43' The opposition give Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post.
40' Timo Gerach blows his whistle. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
35' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) heads on.
33' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
32' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
30' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen).
26' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Timo Gerach saw the whole situation.
25' One of the Werder Bremen players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
22' The resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) comes to nothing.
20' Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Timo Gerach blows for a foul.
15' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

12' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to B. Monchengladbach.
12' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.

11' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise pass inside the box from Rocco Reitz and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
6' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
5' Werder Bremen are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
3' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will supervise the game today.
